body:
Source: GitHub issue #672 (bug, false-green, P1-high, area:review). Re-verified on main @ 91d2fba0: packages/lesson-foundry/lib/foundry.mjs:161,221-227. In `findUnbankedClusters`, when a slug-named artifact exists, if `!RECORDS_MEMBERS.test(slugContent)` evaluates to true, the cluster is credited outright as a legacy lesson. For a 0-byte file (e.g. created by `touch`, crash during truncate, or empty output), `slugContent` is `''`, `!RECORDS_MEMBERS.test('')` is true, so a 0-byte file turns `--gate` green (exit 0) instead of failing exit 2. Furthermore, `defaultReadFile` returns `''` on any read error (EACCES, EISDIR), granting whole-cluster credit to unreadable files.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/lesson-foundry`: `bin/lesson-foundry.mjs` (CLI entry point), `lib/foundry.mjs` (findUnbankedClusters, loadFindings, defaultReadFile), `lib/report.mjs`, `lib/spec-gap.mjs`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry` from the worktree root. Note: existing tests in `test/stable-cluster-id.test.mjs` test legacy credit; ensure valid legacy artifacts with non-empty content still receive credit.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/lesson-foundry/lib/foundry.mjs`: `defaultReadFile(path)` returns `null` on throw instead of `''` so callers can distinguish an empty file from a read error.
2. In `packages/lesson-foundry/lib/foundry.mjs`: in `findUnbankedClusters`, when checking `outDir/${name}${suffix}`, only grant legacy filename-based credit if `slugContent` is non-null, `slugContent.trim() !== ''`, and `!RECORDS_MEMBERS.test(slugContent)`. A 0-byte, whitespace-only, or unreadable file must never grant legacy credit.
3. A 0-byte or unreadable defense file leaves the cluster unbanked, causing `lesson-foundry --gate` to exit 2 with gate failure.
4. Documentation: update `packages/lesson-foundry/README.md` and make the SAME edit by hand in `docs/tools/lesson-foundry.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/lesson-foundry.mdx` (hand-maintained mirrors — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 A 0-byte defense file in `.adlc/lessons/` does not grant legacy credit; cluster remains unbanked. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/empty-defense-file.test.mjs`
- AC2 An unreadable defense file (e.g. read error) does not grant legacy credit; cluster remains unbanked. verify: `node --test packages/lesson-foundry/test/empty-defense-file.test.mjs`
- AC3 Existing valid legacy defense files with content still receive legacy credit. verify: `npm test -w packages/lesson-foundry`
- AC4 Docs updated in all three mirror files. verify: `grep -c "non-empty" packages/lesson-foundry/README.md docs/tools/lesson-foundry.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/lesson-foundry.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC5 Mutation gate green on branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12`

OUT OF SCOPE: Issue #671 (missing ledger opError) or #673 (malformed ledger lines in denominator).
title: lesson-foundry: require non-empty content for legacy defense credit and treat unreadable files as unbanked
